scoring_justification: Compute-driven reproduction: band gaps and barriers are produced by re-running DFT/NEB; the verifier cannot recompute them from raw artifacts in its sandbox. Result-level comparison to paper reference with tolerances is acceptable.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for band gaps and diffusion barriers from the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: λ-MnO₂ band gap 1.079 eV, composite band gap 0 eV (metallic). Diffusion barriers: Li in MnO₂ 1.09 eV, Li composite 0.76 eV, Na MnO₂ 1.31 eV, Mg MnO₂ 1.53 eV, Na composite 0.91 eV, Mg composite 1.15 eV, Li graphene 0.058 eV. Ordering Li<Na<Mg.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's results section and figures.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Gold matches the paper's reported quantitative claims; used solely to assess reproduction fidelity.

diffusion_ordering_pure.description: List of ions ['Li','Na','Mg'] sorted by increasing barrier in pure λ-MnO₂.

diffusion_ordering_composite.description: List of ions ['Li','Na','Mg'] sorted by increasing barrier in the composite.

outputs.description: Scored artifact containing the computed band gaps (eV) and diffusion energy barriers (eV) for Li⁺, Na⁺ and Mg²⁺ in λ-MnO₂ and λ-MnO₂/graphene, along with the relative ordering.
